reading: Germany has blamed Russia for a failed drone attack on Leipzig airport, prompting calls for a stronger European response.
Moscow rejects the allegation that it targeted a Ukrainian cargo aircraft.
An explosive drone at the airport was made safe using a robot.
Leipzig is an important Nato hub and is regularly used by Ukrainian transport aircraft.
The European Commission and Nato have vowed to increase pressure on Russia.
Nato’s leadership has also affirmed its support for Germany.
Berlin announced plans to close a Russian consulate and a Russian cultural institution.
Moscow responded by announcing the closure of German cultural centres in Russia.
European ministers are considering tighter enforcement of sanctions alongside additional visa restrictions.
Russia is accused of acting more recklessly.
